(680-682), the file-error message (1411) and 'Update of record failed' (1490) are set unconditionally and overwrite any earlier message.
Confirmed for COCRDUPC: after the detail edits, no INPUT-ERROR sets state 'N'. The state was set to 'E' (CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK) at 696 before the edits, so a failed edit leaves 'E'.

Confirmed; only performed when CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED (645-647). A blank account sets INPUT-ERROR (mandatory). The non-numeric message is the literal 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' (744-746), not an 88-level value.
Confirmed; blank card sets INPUT-ERROR and 'Card number not provided'; non-numeric uses the literal 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' (787-790).

existing_rules_reviewed.anchor: IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK SET NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED TO TRUE
existing_rules_reviewed.note: Confirmed; the 'No input received' SET is unconditional and replaces 'Account number not provided'. CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA is cleared to LOW-VALUES on this path (653).

Confirmed. The detail edits are also skipped when the state is already 'N' (validated) or 'C' (done) (685-686). The compared group includes name, expiry year/month/day and status; CVV is not part of CCUP-*-CARDDATA.

existing_rules_reviewed.anchor: INSPECT CARD-NAME-CHECK CONVERTING LIT-ALL-ALPHA-FROM TO LIT-ALL-SPACES-TO
existing_rules_reviewed.note: Confirmed; messages 'Card name not provided' and 'Card name can only contain alphabets and spaces' (181-184).
Confirmed; FLG-YES-NO-VALID accepts only upper-case 'Y' and 'N' (91), so lower-case input is rejected. Message 'Card Active Status must be Y or N'.
Confirmed; VALID-MONTH VALUES 1 THRU 12 on the PIC 9(2) redefinition (93-95); message 'Card expiry month must be between 1 and 12'.
Confirmed; VALID-YEAR VALUES 1950 THRU 2099 (96-99); message 'Invalid card expiry year'. No check that the expiry date is in the future and the expiry day is not validated.

no_rule_decisions.reason: Presentation: chooses which values (blank, fetched or edited) are displayed for each state.
Message housekeeping: info line text chosen from the update state (state transitions are covered by BR-COCRDUPC-008..011).
Cursor positioning on the first field in error.
Screen colour/highlight attributes for fields in error, info message and function-key line.
Technical abend handling: default abend message text.

observations.text: CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD is never populated from the screen or the fetched record (only cleared by INITIALIZE CCUP-NEW-DETAILS at 585), yet it is moved via CARD-CVV-CD-X/CARD-CVV-CD-N into CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD, so the REWRITE stores a CVV derived from spaces instead of the existing CVV (Inferred from 306, 585, 1464-1465).

The card is read by card number only and the account typed by the user is never compared with CARD-ACCT-ID; the REWRITE then stores CC-ACCT-ID-N as the card's account, so a card can be re-assigned to whatever account was entered on the search screen (Inferred from 1379-1383 and 1463).

The expiry day comes from the screen (EXPDAYI at 621), is never validated, and is written into the expiry date; the field is not enterable and is darkened via DFHBMDAR moved to the colour attribute EXPDAYC.

The ELSE branch setting CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED under WHEN CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS appears unreachable: 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS leaves the state 'S' only when NO-CHANGES-DETECTED, otherwise it changes it to 'E' or 'N' (Inferred from 684-696, 710-714).
On exit the program unconditionally sets CDEMO-USRTYP-USER, overwriting an admin user type in the commarea.
RESP of RECEIVE MAP and SEND MAP is captured but never tested.
CRDNAMEO is listed twice in the same MOVE (harmless duplication).
'END-IF EXIT' places an EXIT statement inside the IF sentence of 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC; it has no effect.

Several 88-level messages are defined but unused (SEARCHED-ACCT-ZEROES, SEARCHED-ACCT-NOT-NUMERIC, SEARCHED-CARD-NOT-NUMERIC, DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-CARDXREF, XREF-READ-ERROR, CODING-TO-BE-DONE); edits use hardcoded literals.
Valid expiry year range 1950-2099 is hardcoded in an 88-level.

paragraphs.logic: Sets ABEND-ROUTINE as abend handler, initializes work areas and clears WS-RETURN-MSG. On EIBCALEN 0 or first entry from COMEN01C it initializes the commarea and sets CDEMO-PGM-ENTER / CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, else restores CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA. After mapping the AID and validating it, an EVALUATE routes: PF3 or finished/failed update from the card list -> SYNCPOINT and XCTL to caller/menu; entry or PF12 from COCRDLIC -> read card and show details; fresh entry -> blank search screen; after done/failed -> reset and prompt for new keys; otherwise process inputs, decide action and send the map.

rules.anchor: IF CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET EQUAL LIT-CCLISTMAPSET MOVE ZEROS TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID
rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT; XCTL with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; CDEMO-USRTYP-USER and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER set
rules.statement: The program exits when PF3 is pressed, or automatically when an update has completed or failed and the user originally came from the card list (last mapset COCRDLI). It commits (SYNCPOINT) and XCTLs to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM/TRANID, or to COMEN01C/CM00 when those are blank; when returning to the card list the account and card numbers in the commarea are zeroed.

rules.outcome: Invalid keys silently mapped to CCARD-AID-ENTER
rules.statement: Accepted keys are ENTER, PF3, PF5 only when changes have been validated but not yet confirmed, and PF12 only after card details have been fetched; any other key is treated as ENTER.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-CCLISTPGM
rules.statement: On first entry from the card list COCRDLIC (or PF12 when the caller is COCRDLIC), the account and card from the commarea are trusted as valid keys: the card is read and its details shown for editing without key edits.

rules.conditions: CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, or CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = 'COMEN01C' and not re-enter
messages: Please enter Account and Card Number
rules.outcome: WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA initialized; search screen sent; state not fetched / re-enter
rules.statement: On a fresh entry (details not fetched and first entry, or first entry from the main menu) the program shows an empty search screen asking for account and card number.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED INITIALIZE WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA
rules.outcome: State reset to not fetched; search screen sent
rules.statement: After an update has completed or failed (and the user did not come from the card list), the next interaction resets the update state, working storage and the commarea account/card numbers and prompts for new search keys.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER of the main EVALUATE
rules.statement: In every other situation the screen input is received and edited, the next action is decided from the update state, and the screen is redisplayed.

rules.anchor: IF CRDNAMEI OF CCRDUPAI = '*' OR CRDNAMEI OF CCRDUPAI = SPACES
rules.statement: An input of '*' or spaces in the account, card, name, status, expiry month or expiry year field is treated as not supplied (LOW-VALUES); the expiry day is taken from the screen as is.

rules.conditions: CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED or PF12; both key flags valid; card found
rules.statement: When details are not yet fetched, or the user presses PF12 to cancel changes, the card is (re)read only if both the account and card keys are valid; if found, the state becomes show details, discarding any edits.

rules.anchor: IF INPUT-ERROR OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED CONTINUE ELSE SET CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED TO TRUE
rules.statement: While details are shown, changes become 'validated, awaiting confirmation' only when there is no input error and a change was detected; when edits failed the state stays 'changes not OK' and the user must correct the fields.

rules.anchor: WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE SET CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS TO TRUE
rules.outcome: 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING; CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION set to L, F, S or C
rules.statement: Validated changes are saved only when the user confirms with PF5. The outcome sets the state: lock failure -> 'L' (Changes unsuccessful), rewrite failure -> 'F' (Changes unsuccessful), record changed by another user -> back to show details with the refreshed values, otherwise 'C' (Changes committed to database).

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE SET CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS TO TRUE
rules.conditions: State N without PF5; state C
rules.outcome: No action, or CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS with commarea keys zeroed
rules.statement: Without PF5 a validated change is simply redisplayed awaiting confirmation. After a successful save the details are shown again; when there is no calling transaction the commarea account, card and account status are cleared.
An update state not handled by the decision logic is treated as a program error: ABEND-ROUTINE sends 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' and the task abends with code 9999.

rules.anchor: INSPECT CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER
rules.statement: When the card is found, the values fetched for later comparison are saved with the embossed name converted to upper case and the expiry date split into year (1-4), month (6-7) and day (9-10).

messages: Did not find cards for this search condition
rules.statement: The card to update is located in CARDDAT by card number only; the account number is not part of the key and is not compared with CARD-ACCT-ID. Not found gives 'Did not find cards for this search condition'; other responses give a 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT' message.

messages: Could not lock record for update
rules.statement: If the card record cannot be read for update (lock), the update is abandoned with 'Could not lock record for update'.

messages: Record changed by some one else. Please review
rules.outcome: No REWRITE; CCUP-OLD-* refreshed; state returns to show details
rules.statement: Optimistic concurrency: before rewriting, the locked record's CVV, upper-cased embossed name, expiry year/month/day and active status must equal the values fetched when the details were shown; otherwise the update is not applied, the message 'Record changed by some one else. Please review' is set and the stored old values are refreshed from the current record.

rules.outcome: EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE(CARDDAT); LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED on error
rules.statement: The rewritten card record is built from the screen values: card number, account number from the (protected) account field, CVV from CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD, embossed name as typed, expiry date formatted 'YYYY-MM-DD' from new year, month and day, and the new active status. A REWRITE failure sets 'Update of record failed'.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE MOVE DFHBMPRF TO ACCTSIDA OF CCRDUPAI
rules.outcome: DFHBMFSE / DFHBMPRF attributes on input fields
rules.statement: Which fields may be edited depends on the update state: before fetch only the account and card keys are enterable; while showing details or correcting errors only name, status, expiry month and year are enterable; once validated or saved all fields are protected. The expiry day is never enterable.

sme_questions.question: Is the CVV supposed to be preserved on update? The rewrite takes it from CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD, which is never filled.
Should the update verify that the card belongs to the entered account (and keep CARD-ACCT-ID unchanged), rather than writing the screen account number into the record?
Should an expiry date in the past be rejected, and should the expiry day be editable/validated? Today only month 1-12 and year 1950-2099 are checked.
Should lower-case 'y'/'n' be accepted for the active status (the change detection compares upper-cased data but the status edit is case-sensitive)?

summary.text: COCRDUPC is a pseudo-conversational CICS program (transaction CCUP, mapset COCRDUP, map CCRDUPA) that updates one credit card record in the CARDDAT VSAM file. The user first supplies (or receives from the card list COCRDLIC) an account number and card number; the card is read by card number and its embossed name, active status and expiry month/year are shown for editing. Edited values are validated (name alphabetic, status Y/N, month 1-12, year 1950-2099); when valid the user is asked to press PF5, after which the record is read for UPDATE, compared with the values originally fetched (optimistic concurrency) and rewritten. A state machine in CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION (not fetched, show details, changes not OK, validated not confirmed, done, lock error, failed) carried in the commarea drives screen content, field protection and messages. PF3 (or completion when entered from the card list) issues SYNCPOINT and XCTLs back to the caller or main menu COMEN01C; PF12 cancels changes by re-reading the card.
